This game uses an AUTO-SAVE system.

Do not close the game when the AUTO-SAVE icon is on-screen.

Collected items will not be saved until the boss stage is cleared.

Collecting an item inside a cleared boss stage will activate AUTO-SAVE.

You can map your weapons to the gamepad Right Stick and the 1-8 top number keys in the pause menu.

Pressing Right Stick or 9 will reset to the X-Buster.
Once a stage is cleared, hold UP when selecting the stage to skip to the boss room.

Story events contained in stages will replay on revisit.

It's like reading a book's chapter again!

Extra lives will reset everytime you enter a stage.

You can choose how much you want to start with in the EXTRA menu.

Bosses will react differently to certain weapons.

Some of them can be used to counter the boss abilities, so try different combinations!
You can equip or unequip armor parts individually in the Pause Menu.
